description: This Java class defines an immutable data object that encapsulates repayment schedule-related information for a loan, including disbursement dates, currency, principal, and fees.

classes.name: RepaymentScheduleRelatedLoanData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing repayment schedule related information, including disbursement dates, currency, principal, and fee details.

methods.name: disbursementDate
methods.description: Returns the effective disbursement date, prioritizing actualDisbursementDate if available.

methods.name: isDisbursed
methods.description: Indicates whether the loan has been disbursed based on the presence of actualDisbursementDate.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Returns the currency data associated with the loan.

methods.name: getInArrearsTolerance
methods.description: Returns the in arrears tolerance amount.

methods.name: getTotalFeeChargesAtDisbursement
methods.description: Returns the total fee charges at disbursement.

methods.name: disbursementData
methods.description: Constructs and returns a DisbursementData object with relevant disbursement details.
